items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses a situation where Martha Tilton sang a song ('Loch Lomond') that the interviewee had been performing on 52nd Street, noting it became a 'big joke' because the audience knew the interviewee's version. There is no evidence of personal interaction, collaboration, or direct acq

ctx.x: And I was in New York with a small combination, (shivering). It ran on for quite a while.
There's also a record that you hear occasionally on the nostalgia stations of Martha Tilton.
